mapper.insert: insert ignore into seckill_coupon_claim_settlement (coupon_id, status, reconcile_attempts, next_reconcile_time, create_time, update_time) select sc.id, 'PENDING', 0, now(), now(), now() from seckill_coupon sc left join seckill_coupon_claim_settlement settlement on settlement.coupon_id = sc.id where sc.claim_end_time <= #{readyBefore} and settlement.id is null order by sc.claim_end_time asc, sc.id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update seckill_coupon_claim_settlement set status = 'PROCESSING', reconcile_attempts = reconcile_attempts + 1, next_reconcile_time = null, processing_deadline = #{processingDeadline}, processing_token = #{processingToken}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{expectedStatus}

update seckill_coupon_claim_settlement set reconcile_attempts = reconcile_attempts + 1, processing_deadline = #{processingDeadline}, processing_token = #{processingToken}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PROCESSING' and ( processing_deadline <= #{now} or (processing_deadline is null and update_time <= #{legacyLeaseExpiredBefore}) )

update seckill_coupon_claim_settlement set status = #{settlement.status}, next_reconcile_time = #{settlement.nextReconcileTime}, processing_deadline = null, processing_token = null, total_stock = #{settlement.totalStock}, mysql_remaining_stock = #{settlement.mysqlRemainingStock}, mysql_claim_count = #{settlement.mysqlClaimCount}, redis_remaining_stock = #{settlement.redisRemainingStock}, redis_user_count = #{settlement.redisUserCount}, redis_claim_count = #{settlement.redisClaimCount}, unresolved_failure_count = #{settlement.unresolvedFailureCount}, resolution_code = #{settlement.resolutionCode}, resolution_message = #{settlement.resolutionMessage}, last_checked_time = now(), settled_time = case when #{settlement.status} = 'CONSISTENT' then now() else null end, update_time = now() where id = #{settlement.id} and status = 'PROCESSING' and processing_token = #{settlement.processingToken}
